name: citadel-web
description: Build-time toolchain for the browser side of Citadel. Two things live here: the legacy esbuild bundle for the React Flow diagram on the hand-written / page (kb/static/vendor/, committed), and the Next.js app in web/ (exported to kb/webui/, committed). Neither runs in CI or on Railway; both ship as static files. See docs/web-bundle.md.
